description: Beautiful white sand and a long stretch of secluded beach, make it the perfect place to spend time together with your partner. Cansaulim Beach is located near Dabolim Airport. Along with Arossim beach and Cuelim beach. At a distance of 15 km from Margao of South Goa, it has the fame of being the second largest stretch of beach in India, attracting crowds of tourists throughout the year. This beach gives a breathtaking view with dense groves of palm trees, golden shimmering sand, and the widespread Majestic Ocean. The natural shades of palm trees make this beach a popular spot. If you are looking for a secluded and calmer time then this beach is the perfect place to spend a few memorable moments. Cansaulim Beach is located at a distance of 27 km from Panjim and 15 km from Goa International Airport. This beach is quite popular for swimming. Couples can be seen taking long walks in the serenity of the sea. This beach offers you both, thrill as well as calm seclusion. You can spend time reading a book as you sunbathe or just watch the rise and fall of mesmerizing waves. if you are looking for some adventure then you have various options of watersports to choose from. Water surfing, speedboat rides, water skiing, and parasailing are a few of the sports which you can try here at this beach. There are umpteen numbers of shacks on the beach promising visitors a comfortable time, accompanied by interesting cocktails and delicacies. Not just the beach, the Cansaulim village is visited by many tourists, especially on the 6th of January for the Three Kings Feast. Built-in 1581, Cansaulim Church is also a place worth visiting. There are also many beaches which are located quite close by such as Arossim Beach, Cuelim Beach, and Bogmalo Beach. For accommodation, you will find various hotels which are located near the beach.
